title: Mongolian Beef

items: 1 pound flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
⅓ cup corn starch or potato starch
1 bunch green onions, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Thinly slice the flank steak against the grain. Toss with salt and Shaoxing wine, then coat evenly with corn starch.
Mix all sauce ingredients together in a small bowl and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok or large pan over high heat until smoking. Fry the beef in batches for 2–3 minutes until crispy and golden. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry the sliced white onion for 2 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the sauce and bring to a simmer, stirring for 1 minute until slightly thickened.
Return the beef to the pan and toss to coat. Add the green onions and stir-fry for 1 minute.
tips:
Slice the beef as thin as possible — partially freezing it for 20 minutes makes this easier. Fry in small batches to keep the heat high and get a crispy crust rather than steaming.
Ths recipe also works well with chicken
